And please DO NOT waste your money on the Reliance RESQ plan. It is honestly one of the worst services I have ever seen. They happily take your money but disappear when actual service is needed.

If you value your time, peace of mind, and basic customer respect, avoid Reliance Digital, Phoenix Market City, Kurla and RESQ services completely.
